program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((colors (list 1 4 2))
                  (objs (sort-by (objects g 0) (lambda (o) (* -1 (obj-size o))))))
             (reduce (lambda (acc pair)
                       (let ((idx (fst pair))
                             (obj (snd pair)))
                         (recolor-cells acc (obj-cells obj) (nth colors idx))))
                     g
                     (zip-lists (range 0 (length objs)) objs))))))
